target: forge.sh kind — FORGE= (empty) in env or ./.env counts as not declared, not invalid
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://github.com/o/r.git
fx_config '{"forge":{"kind":"gitlab"}}'
k() { fx_run kind; echo "$1=$FX_OUT rc=$FX_RC"; }
export FORGE=; k envempty
unset FORGE; printf 'FORGE=\n' > .env
k dotenvempty
rm -rf .agentic; printf 'FORGE=gitlab\n' > .env; export FORGE=
k envempty_dotenv
unset FORGE; printf 'FORGE=\n' > .env; fx_setremote https://example.test/o/r.git
k bothempty
fx_done
